messages:
Zoe: Friday night poll / movie night at Casa Cinema (8pm) or pizza + board games at Ben's (7pm)? :popcorn: :pizza:
Carlos: Pizza + games please. Ill bring a 4-cheese and my terrible Monopoly strategy.
Mei: Oof monopoly = long. can we do Catan or Coup instead?
Ben: Catan + pizza sounds ideal. my couch fits 5 people max though.
Zoe: If Casa Cinema, we can do the 8:10 showing of "Moonlight Bites" (heard it's fun). cheaper tickets.
Carlos: How about this: pizza at Ben's at 7, then quick movie at 9 for anyone who wants to keep going?
Mei: That works. I prefer pizza first. early dinner.
Ben: Ill order 2 large + 1 veggie. any allergies? @Carlos you okay with gluten?
Carlos: Gluten free here. thanks for asking. I can bring GF mini pizzas.
snacks-bot: poll: "Friday plans" options: [Pizza+Games, Movie at Casa Cinema, Both (Pizza then Movie)] current votes: Pizza+Games (2), Movie (0), Both (1)
Zoe: Looks like pizza & games wins. Ben, mind if I bring chips + a playlist?
Ben: Please do! also ping me your arrival time so I can prep couches.
Carlos: Ill aim for 6:45pm to help with setup.
Mei: See you all Friday :tada:
